title: Student Schematic Plan Blocks Draft
description: A human-authored schematic plan blocks draft written over one valid ARCH-106 plan framework without unresolved items. Each confirmed level carries one local rectangular container and one local placement per confirmed space with student-written x and y and a rotation of 0 or 90 degrees. Width and depth are never written here: they follow from the ARCH-100 human-selected long and short sides. The builder only checks consistency, coverage, containment, non-overlap, and declared adjacent/separate geometry; it never arranges, optimizes, or draws anything.

source_plan_framework_sha256.description: The canonical JSON plus newline SHA-256 of the whole ARCH-106 plan framework this draft answers.

width_m.description: Local sketch frame width in metres; finite and strictly positive (greater than zero). Not a site boundary or building outline; a zero-area frame is invalid.

depth_m.description: Local sketch frame depth in metres; finite and strictly positive (greater than zero). Not a site boundary or building outline; a zero-area frame is invalid.

x_m.description: Student-written local x in metres from the level sketch origin; finite and non-negative.

y_m.description: Student-written local y in metres from the level sketch origin; finite and non-negative.

rotation_degrees.description: Exactly 0 or 90 degrees; 0 maps width to the selected long side, 90 maps width to the selected short side.

clarification_questions.description: At most three human-authored questions, carried verbatim; the builder never adds questions.
